info.title: Voice platform API
info.description: Agent and call contracts. Local in-process calls need no HTTP key. HTTP servers authenticate every private operation. Shape validation never grants authority.

prompt.description: At most 16384 UTF-8 bytes; servers parse the canonical runtime schema.

serverKey.description: Configured server key. The host derives scope and grants; callers cannot select a scope in an input object.

callGrant.description: Single-call exchange grant, bound to origin and proof key. Recoverable only for the same authenticated exchange operation and hash.

callControl.description: Revocable single-call stop and control-renewal authority; requires browser proof and grants no account access.

webhookSignature.name: x-webhook-signature
webhookSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over id.timestamp.exactBody, encoded as v1, followed by base64. Verify with the released signing module.

post.summary: Deliver a scoped call lifecycle event
post.description: Retries preserve the event id and exact body. Receivers verify signature and timestamp and deduplicate by event id. A call has exactly one terminal event, ended or failed. Content already delivered is outside the sender storage boundary.
